android.desc:
Sonos Widget Plus puts your Sonos system right on your home screen. No more
    digging through apps — control music, switch rooms, start your favorite
    playlists and adjust volume with a single tap.

    🎵 BEAUTIFUL DESIGN
    The widget is built to look good. Album art fills the card, the controls sit
    exactly where your thumb expects them, and a smooth animated equalizer tells
    you at a glance whether anything is playing.

    🎨 FULLY CUSTOMIZABLE
    Three independent color pickers let you make the widget yours:
    • Background color — 10 curated palettes (Slate, Onyx, Midnight, Forest, Plum,
      Sunset, Carbon, Sonos Yellow, Red, White)
    • Accent color — recolors the play button and the equalizer bars (10 colors)
    • Controls color — recolors every other element: track title, volume bars,
      progress bar, room chip, next / previous icons (10 colors plus Auto)
    • Transparency — slide from fully opaque to 100% transparent for a
      floating-controls look that lets your wallpaper show through

    📻 ONE-TAP FAVORITES
    Pin up to five Spotify favorites or Sonos playlists directly to the widget.
    Tap once and they start playing on your selected room — no app launches,
    no playlist drilling. The album disc animates the moment you tap.

    🏠 MULTI-ROOM CONTROL
    • Switch which Sonos room the widget controls by tapping the room chip
    • Add more rooms to the playback group from the room picker
    • Volume with discrete preset levels (1 to 5 buttons, your choice) or a
      fine-grained slider

    ⏱️ SMOOTH PROGRESS COUNTDOWN
    The track countdown clock updates every second, smoothly — no jerky
    once-per-update jumps. The progress bar matches.

    📐 TWO WIDGET SIZES
    • Medium (4×2): now-playing controls, room selection, volume
    • Large (4×3): everything in medium plus the favorites row

    🔒 PRIVACY-FIRST
    • No accounts, no sign-ups, no developer-operated servers
    • No analytics, no advertising SDKs, no crash reporting, no tracking
    • Your music history, room names and favorites never reach the developer
    • The only internet requests are anonymous fetches for album-art thumbnails
      — no personal data ever leaves your device

    ⚙️ HOW IT WORKS
    The widget talks to your Sonos speakers using their built-in UPnP control
    protocol over your home Wi-Fi network. No Sonos account is required —
